title: SB2475 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB2648.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 2475); copied from TN-HB-2648-2023.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft as filed, 2024-01-31; shared document with HB 2648. Section 3 deletes and replaces all of 39-17-1366. Effective July 1, 2024.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1307, is amended by deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1313(a), is amended by deleting "or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g)".
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1366): (a) A concealed handgun carry permit issued prior to July 1, 2024, is not eligible for renewal and remains valid until its expiration; provided, that the permit holder is not prohibited from possessing a firearm in this state pursuant to § 39-17-1307(b), 18 U.S.C. § 922(g), or any other state or federal law.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1366): (b) A person issued a concealed handgun carry permit may exchange the permit for an enhanced handgun carry permit upon payment of a processing fee of thirty-five dollars ($35.00) and proof of successful completion of a handgun safety course in accordance with § 39-17-1351(e); provided, that the permit holder is not prohibited from possessing a firearm in this state pursuant to § 39-17-1307(b), 18 U.S.C. § 922(g), or any other state or federal law.
